_comment: EGM Downloader Mac update feed. Upload to egerena.com/apps/egmac-update.json
_version_notes: Fixed: downloads from Kick.com and other sites requiring browser impersonation were failing due to a dependency version issue
Electron runtime updated to v43.4.0 — includes upstream Chromium and Node.js stability and security updates

notes: Fixed: downloads from Kick.com and other sites requiring browser impersonation were failing due to a dependency version issue
Electron runtime updated to v43.4.0 — includes upstream Chromium and Node.js stability and security updates
Minor internal test suite cleanup
New: a Patreon link in the footer, next to Support EGM, for anyone who'd like to help fund development
Fixed: hovering the active-downloads row in the Subscriptions queue could make it hard to read
New: Diagnostics can now show raw Flask output too, alongside the existing yt-dlp toggle — everything you'd see running the app from a terminal

New: Diagnostics can now also show raw ffmpeg output during H.264 encoding/upscale conversions, alongside the yt-dlp and Flask toggles — now including hardware-encoder failure details, previously invisible, for easier GPU troubleshooting
The Diagnostics toggles now show compact tool names (yt-dlp / Flask / ffmpeg) with the full description as a hover tooltip, to keep the titlebar tidy in longer languages
Fixed: the taskbar/dock progress badge (added in v1.3.4) wasn't showing for downloads started from Subscriptions
Up up down down left right left right B A — still doesn't unlock anything. Now multilingual.
Electron runtime updated to v43.3.0 — includes upstream Chromium and Node.js stability and security updates
New: the taskbar/dock icon now shows download/conversion progress and an active-job count badge, for downloads started from the main window or from Subscriptions
The app now prevents your system from sleeping while a download or conversion is running
The Log Console is now called Diagnostics, and it's easier to find — available directly from the footer (next to Help) and from the Subscriptions window, instead of buried in Advanced settings
Download error messages are now translated into your language where possible, with clearer guidance for common cases (like members-only videos)
Fixed: the reorder arrows on a multi-video fetch could show incorrectly or not update after fetching info for a video
The diagnostic log file no longer includes full download links or file names, for better privacy
Expanded internal test coverage for this cycle's fixes

New: Log Console (Advanced > Maintenance) — a read-only window showing the app's live diagnostic log, with an option to also show raw yt-dlp output and export the log to a file, for easier troubleshooting
Conversion now shows real progress — a percentage and filling bar instead of just a spinner, when the conversion step supports it
Download cards and the subscriptions queue now show the estimated time remaining (ETA) alongside speed
Checking for updates (yt-dlp, ffmpeg, plugins) now feels noticeably faster — the lookups run in parallel instead of one after another
Repeated update checks are now protected against hitting GitHub's request limit, which could previously cause version info to briefly show as "unknown"
Added a small diagnostic log file to help troubleshoot issues if they come up
Minor internal code cleanup — no user-facing changes
